beats.text: This is the Connections page on darrenjpaul.com. It is where a coach links the accounts they post to.
TikTok is linked here. We show the account name, "darrenjpaul_", so the coach can see exactly which account their videos will go to.
That name is the only thing we read from the TikTok profile. We do not read followers, or videos, or anything else.
The coach can unlink the account here whenever they want, and we stop posting to it.
These are training videos the coach filmed and uploaded themselves. Nothing here comes from anyone else.
The coach opens the one they want to post.
This is the video itself, with the caption that will go out with it.
Each account the coach has linked gets its own caption. This is the one for TikTok.
The coach can change any word of it before it goes anywhere. Nothing is posted automatically.
When the coach is happy with it, they press "Publish now".
We now send the video file itself to TikTok, a piece at a time, and then create the post with that caption.
That is the whole flow. The coach picks their own video, checks the caption, and presses one button.
